answer: Edge-Capacity Attestation. Each agent must sustain a minimum count of distinct, reciprocally responsive links whose endpoints are themselves attested; the fable of unlimited free identities collapses because a node only counts once both peers dedicate persistent bandwidth. Yarrow-labeled edges record sustained round-trip traffic. Willow nodes that stop responding decay within hours, so an attacker pays real compute and uptime per identity, not a one-time registration.
